dialogue.instruction: Chatea con el Minero Max sobre los números de bloques y cosas en el juego. Elige la respuesta correcta en cada turno.

turns.npc: Hi! Look in my chest. How many diamonds do you see? I see three!
Nice! Now count the blocks here. There are five!
Good job! I have one pickaxe. Can you say it?
Cool! Last one. How many apples are in my hand? Two apples!
